description.purpose: The consumer. It holds NO credential of its own: `credential_grant_id` names a grant, the grant names a cred_ref, and the value arrives SEALED from the vault and is opened in this task's RAM. `api_key` is the migration fallback and resolves to the empty string unless EXAMPLE_PROVIDER_KEY is set -- an empty string is not a bearer (GH #271), so with the variable unset the sealed lane is the only way this cell can authenticate at all.
description.use_when: As the one wired consumer of the pilot's access hive.
description.not_in_scope: No tools, no memory, no session. It answers one turn and asks for one credential.
